set.body: Scala 3.3.8 scaladoc (sbt 1.12.9, Homebrew JDK 25.0.1) now crashes on coreJVM/doc and coreJS/doc with NullPointerException in dotty.tools.scaladoc.translators.SignatureBuilder.content() (termParamList <- functionParameters <- ScalaSignatureProvider.methodLikeSignature <- MemberRenderer.memberSignature). Deterministic, and it fails at every commit tried, including 80841b6 (start of 2026-10-02 session) - yet publishLocal (which builds doc jars) succeeded at 22:50 and 23:00 for f71e805/5a27028 on the same JDK. Ruled out: JDK change, coursier cache (scaladoc/tasty jars dated June), ~/.sbt global settings/plugins, git tags, doc scalacOptions, scaladoc -siteroot (docs/). Also: sbt lint reports Compile / doc / tags (scaladocTag -> 1) as unused, so the intended doc concurrency limit has no effect. Release-blocking: doc jars cannot be built. Next: rerun with scaladoc -verbose / a debugger to name the member, try JDK 21/22 (sbt -java-home), and compare an sbt session from before 22:50 if any state (e.g. ~/.sbt/1.0/zinc, /tmp) changed. Workaround in place: tools/check-browser-consumer.sh publishes code artifacts only (0852c31).
set.title: [Intaglio] scaladoc crashes (NPE in SignatureBuilder) - doc jars cannot be built
